mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may increase cenobamate levels and CNS side effects, while cenobamate may have additive CNS depression effects.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and cenobamate concentrations closely; ensure adequate hydration and consider dose adjustment of cenobamate if renal impairment develops during amphotericin B therapy.
